start.name_zh: 柳州输气站（柳江区流山镇流山村）
start.name_en: Liuzhou Gas Transmission Station (Liushan Village, Liushan Town, Liujiang District) -- on the China-Myanmar gas pipeline branch trunk line
start.geocode_source: Nominatim query '流山镇,柳州' (https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search?q=%E6%B5%81%E5%B1%B1%E9%95%87%2C%E6%9F%B3%E5%B7%9E) -- town-level administrative boundary centroid. Exact village/town name from a sohu.com on-camera interview with 广西广投天然气管网有限公司柳州分输站站长刘卫东 (station chief): '起点是在柳江区流山镇流山村柳州输气站'.

end.name_zh: 柳州分输站（柳南区太阳村镇新圩村）
end.name_en: Liuzhou Distribution Station (Xinxu Village, Taiyangcun Town, Liunan District)
end.geocode_source: Nominatim query '新圩村,柳南区' (https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search?q=%E6%96%B0%E5%9C%A9%E6%9D%91%2C%E6%9F%B3%E5%8D%97%E5%8C%BA) -- village-level administrative boundary centroid. Same interview: '经过十二个村到柳南区太阳村镇新圩村柳州分输站'. This is the same 柳州分输站 later expanded to also feed sibling branch P7657 (Liucheng Branch).

corridor_notes: 27km branch line from a China-Myanmar-gas-pipeline transmission station in Liushan Town, Liujiang District, passing through twelve villages, to the Liuzhou distribution station in Taiyangcun Town, Liunan District (china5e.com: '该管道起于中缅天然气管道支干线柳州输气站...终于柳南区太阳村镇新圩村柳州分输站...沿线经过柳江区、柳南区两个区'; sohu.com station-chief quote gives the village-level detail: '起点是在柳江区流山镇流山村柳州输气站，经过十二个村到柳南区太阳村镇新圩村柳州分输站'). Overall direction northwest-to-southeast. Construction started 2015-08-28; entered trial operation 2017-12-05. Design capacity 3.70x10^8 Nm3/yr (0.37 bcm/y), matching GEM exactly.
researcher_notes: Builds directly on the prior pilot pass, which had already verified existence/route/length/capacity/construction-date via these same three refs but only had a paraphrased route description (district-level only). This pass fetched china5e.com and sohu.com directly (raw curl, not AI-summarized) and extracted the literal station names and village-level route description, upgrading endpoint precision from district-level to village-level for both ends. Note the three refs (china5e.com, tzcjj.liuzhou.gov.cn per pilot, sohu.com) all trace to one original wire story per project rules and do not count as 2 independent sources on their own; jz.docin.com (the EIA-filing listing, uploaded by a different party in 2020) is the genuinely separate second origin. Prior pilot's flagged StartMonth1 concern (sheet says 2017-05; sources say trial operation began Dec 2017) is a data-field issue outside this task's endpoint-geometry scope but is reiterated here for the record.
